newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA WINS $20 MLN U.S. GSM NETWORK DEAL.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA WINS $20 MLN U.S. GSM NETWORK DEAL.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia said in a statement on Tuesday it will deliver digital GSM 1900 network equipment to U.S. Wireless Alliance LCC.

"...(Nokia) has signed a multiyear contract valued at $20 million to supply Wireless Alliance, LCC with digital GSM 1900 network equipment for its Personal Communications Services digital system," Nokia said.
Nokia said the initial phase of the contract includes the delivery of GSM 1900 base station controllers and high-capacity indoor base stations as well as PrimeSite base stations.
Nokia said it would start installing the network equipment in August.
